note: website_forum.forum.forum loses two search_count-in-a-loop counters to one _read_group: 26 -> 24. This is the OTHER remedy ADR-0052 admits -- the module docstring says a compute that already uses _read_group is correct as written -- and it is the one that fits a filtered domain, which fields.Count cannot express. Both domains differed from each other only by state and from record to record only by forum_id, so one grouped query over ("forum_id", "in", self.ids) serves the whole recordset for both counters. Neither compute declared an @api.depends at all; the merged one depends on post_ids.state. Verified against the query it replaces, forum by forum, including an archived pending post that active_test must still exclude: six comparisons, all equal.
